items.text: Michelle Pennington is managing director of Medill Partners, a real estate holding and development company. Her campaign says she studied economics at DePaul University and has worked with nonprofits supporting Chicago Public Schools. She says she is a member of the Illinois Water Environment Association.

items.text: Her campaign says she wants to review the MWRD budget for waste and work to lower property tax bills. She says every dollar should go toward clean water and flood prevention instead of outside programs. Pennington has called on the MWRD to secure abandoned properties in Harvey and provide transparency to affected taxpayers.
